programs.title: Omnibus: Nureyev
programs.desc: Theatre and film director Lindsay Anderson in conversation with ballet superstar Rudolf Nureyev. First broadcast in 1974.

programs.title: Nature: The Classical Collection
programs.desc: The natural world has always been a powerful inspiration to composers, and this programme takes us on an evocative journey through some of the best-loved musical responses.

programs.title: Sex Symbols: Talking Pictures
programs.desc: Sylvia Syms looks at the handsome heroes, gorgeous heroines, pin-ups and bombshells who came to be known as cinema's greatest sex symbols, hearing from the stars themselves.

programs.title: Eve and Marilyn
programs.desc: Eve Arnold photographed Marilyn Monroe in the 1950s and 60s and became the star's trusted confidante. She talks about Monroe and how their friendship developed.

programs.title: Jane Russell: Scene by Scene
programs.desc: Hollywood sex symbol Jane Russell talks about her difficult childhood as the eldest and only girl of six siblings, her film career and working with Marilyn Monroe.
